newsitem.title: ESTONIA: SOOTS SHARE ISSUE OVERSUBSCRIBED 30 TIMES.
newsitem.headline: SOOTS SHARE ISSUE OVERSUBSCRIBED 30 TIMES.

text.p: Estonia's catering company Soots Turism share issue was oversubscribed 30 times, Hoiupank Investments said on Tuesday.
Soots Turism issued 540,000 shares and investors subscribed for 15.2 million shares, Raul Hindov, a project leader for Hoiupank Investments, told Reuters.
Most of the 150 subscribers were private investors, he added.
Hoiupank Investments will seek a listing for Soots Turism on the secondary list of the Tallinn stock exchange, Hindov said.
"We hope the company is suitable for the secondary list as the condition of a minimum 100 shareholders has been fulfilled," Hindov added.
The share issue, which closed on Monday, increases the share capital of Soots Turism to 14 million kroons.
